meta.notes: Served by ShotoPhopEX's native worker (gn-diffusion qwen-2.1/angles): the Qwen-Image-2.1 edit with gribbliest's QMA camera-angles LoRA (huggingface.co/gribbliest/qwen-image-2.1-qma-camera-angles, revision 13007eec, model card Apache-2.0, read 2026-11-19) at strength 1 in front of the request's own LoRAs, at the card's 30 steps and CFG 3. The prompt is the LoRA's vocabulary, `<qma> {azimuth} {elevation} {distance}` (the same 8 x 4 x 3 words as 2511's fal LoRA), then the camera move in plain words, built by generate.angles. generate.angles runs it on every card but the Mac build (owner's call, 2026-11-19): on the 5090 it kept the scene and the person, where akhaliq's 2.1 Multiple Angles LoRA left a cut-out on grey. No ComfyUI graph.
